title: docs: forms.mdx checklist says public-form "Rate limiting / captcha — not built in", while a built-in, off-by-default limiter (`server.security.rateLimit`) is documented and 429s the anonymous submit
body:
## Finding

Found by the www.objectos.ai seat 1 during the 2026-11-09 rework of the anonymous public forms post (www PR #280), measured on `@objectstack/cli` 18.3.0.

- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx:476` says: "Rate limiting / captcha — not built in".
- `wire-format.mdx:609` and `production-readiness.mdx:20` document a built-in limiter that is off by default: `server.security.rateLimit`.
- Measured with the default setting: 40 anonymous `POST …/forms/contact-us/submit` → 40 × 201 in 0.89 s, so no limit.
- Measured with `server.security.rateLimit` armed: 9 × 201, then `429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` with `retry-after: 6`.

The forms checklist is the page that drifted. Rate limiting is built in, but off by default and server-wide; captcha is indeed not built in.

Suggested fix: reword the checklist line to say rate limiting is opt-in through `server.security.rateLimit`, link that section, and keep "captcha — not built in".

Reach: a public doc page that an operator exposing a public form will read.
